try_kidney_esrd_sickle_cell_or_a_code.source: Try “kidney”, “ESRD”, “sickle cell” or a code like “GB61.5”.

type_speak_or_snap_a_photo_alafia_will.source: Type, speak, or snap a photo — ALAFIA will take you to the right place.
type_speak_or_snap_a_photo_alafia_will.translation: Kọ, sọ̀rọ̀, tàbí gba àwòrán — ALAFIA yóò gba ọ lọ sí ibi tí ó yẹ.

unlock_the_full_alafia_experience_across.source: Unlock the full ALAFIA experience across every device.
unlock_the_full_alafia_experience_across.translation: Ṣí ìfẹ́ ALAFIA kíkún ní gbogbo ẹ̀rọ̀.

upload_a_lab_report_medication_list_or.source: Upload a lab report, medication list or flowsheet. Nothing is added to your records until you review it and choose Import.
upload_a_lab_report_medication_list_or.translation: Gbe ìwé ìsẹ̀wọ̀, àtòjọ oogun tàbí flowsheet. Ohunkóhun kò ní a ṣafikun sí àwọn ìtàn rẹ títí o ba wo ó àti yàn Gbé Wọlé.

upload_image_s_for_alafia_analysis.source: Upload image(s) for Alafia analysis. Several shots of the same meal are read together as one plate.
upload_image_s_for_alafia_analysis.translation: Gbé àwòrán sí Alafia fún ìtúpalẹ̀. Àwòrán púpọ̀ ti oúnjẹ kanna a ka pọ̀ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ìkan.

we_sent_a_link_to_open_it_then_come_back.source: We sent a link to %1$s. Open it, then come back and tap Continue.
we_sent_a_link_to_open_it_then_come_back.translation: A rán ìjápọ̀ sí %1$s. Ṣí i, kí o sì padà wá tẹ Continue.

what_is_never_sent.translation: Ohun tí a kò níí rán

you_have_uploaded_this_file_before.source: You have uploaded this file before — showing what was read then.
you_have_uploaded_this_file_before.translation: Ẹ ti gbe faili yii sile tẹ́lẹ̀ — ẹ pè ohun ti a ka nígbà yẹn.

your_current_password_keeps_working.source: Your current password keeps working until you do.
your_current_password_keeps_working.translation: Ọ̀rọ̀ aṣírí yin lọ́wọ́ ń ṣiṣẹ́ títí o bá ṣe.

your_data_is_protected_according_to.source: Your data is protected according to applicable regulations
your_data_is_protected_according_to.translation: A dáàbò bo àwọn àlàyé rẹ nípa àwọn ìtumọ̀ tó yẹ

your_own_health_record_meals_and.source: Your own health record, meals and tracking live in the patient view.
your_own_health_record_meals_and.translation: Ìwé ìlera rẹ, oúnjẹ àti ìlànà àkọsílẹ̀ wà nínú ìwòran ọ̀jọ́.
